title: TextEDA IR v0.18 — sheet template shard
description: A reusable sheet template: the static furniture of a print page — title block, table, vector logo — and the page extent it gives. The furniture is literal: no project metadata, no variables, no electrical references, no page-specific facts. Lengths are integer nanometers (ADR-0006). The origin is the template's upper-left corner, +x right, +y down. See ADR-0068, ADR-0035.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard; see teda.md §13.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

template_id.description: The template this shard describes, e.g. a4-title-block. Resolved from the file name views/templates/<template_id>.sheet-template.teda.

size.description: The page extent the template gives. A page that uses this template takes this size as its own extent (ADR-0068 D4).

line.description: Straight furniture strokes; rows are sorted by id.

rect.description: Rectangular furniture outlines; rows are sorted by id.

polyline.description: Open polylines, the shape a vector logo is drawn with; rows are sorted by id.

text.description: Static text of the furniture; rows are sorted by id.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute (ADR-0005 rule 8).

point.description: A point in the template's coordinates.

x_nm.description: x from the template's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: y from the template's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

id.description: Row id, unique in the template.

rect.description: One rectangular furniture outline, given by two opposite corners.

id.description: Row id, unique in the template.

end.description: The opposite corner of the rectangle.

polyline.description: One open polyline, drawn through its points in order.

id.description: Row id, unique in the template.

points.description: The points of the polyline, in the order they are drawn.

text.description: One static text of the furniture, drawn with the renderer's fixed view text height.

id.description: Row id, unique in the template.

x_nm.description: Text position, x from the template's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Text position, y from the template's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

text.description: The text; it is literal — no field is interpolated into it.
